title: Renderer→broker governed-turn request (rev-30 §4.10(g))
description: The sole renderer→broker request frame. Carries ONLY a conversation id, an optional authorized agent id, and a NON-authoritative UUIDv4 correlation token. additionalProperties:false rejects any smuggled system/history/generation_config/hash/nonce/run_id/task_id/broker_turn_id/request_nonce/prepared-object/verdict/receipt field ⇒ malformed.

client_request_id.description: NON-authoritative correlation token. Canonical lowercase RFC-4122 v4 UUID.
